name: copilot-routing-v1
description: Routing evaluation dataset for the orchestrator. expected_agents is the ordered list of sub-agents the orchestrator should call for the query; an empty list means the orchestrator should answer directly without calling any agent. Categories: booking (clear booking-agent queries), kb (clear knowledge-base queries), direct (no agent needed), multi (requires both agents), tricky (ambiguous phrasing designed to catch routing mistakes).
